Splat QR codes: phone test sheet

From the study of splat QR codes (October 2026). Scan each code with your phone's camera app, from about 30 cm, straight on, and write down whether it opened the right link or text. Each card says what the study predicts. Codes S01 onward that hold the link should open https://ryanjosephkamp.github.io/splashery/.

Splat softness (wider): softness (splat spread ÷ spacing) = 0.55 (just on the readable side)
